snippet.title: PlayStation - Doraemon - Nobita to Fukkatsu no Hoshi (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Doraemon: Nobita to Fukkatsu no Hoshi is an Action game, developed by SAS Sakata and published by Epoch, which was released in Japan in 1996.
